tests.name: Text-based medical PDF
tests.details: Extracted all clinical parameters (demographics, vitals, labs, history) with 100% exact values and calculated BMI.

tests.name: Scanned medical PDF
tests.details: Detected scanned document without OCR engine and raised clear user error: 'Document appears to be a scanned image with no readable text. The OCR engine (Tesseract) is not installed on this server to read scanned raster pages.'

tests.name: Multi-page laboratory report
tests.details: Accurately mapped 3-page document with Page 1 (vitals), Page 2 (biomarkers), and Page 3 (cardiac telemetry). Total pages analyzed: 3.

tests.name: DOCX medical report
tests.details: Successfully parsed Word (.docx) document including tables, paragraphs, and diagnosis sentences.

tests.name: PDF containing laboratory tables
tests.details: Disambiguated 10/10 laboratory table rows. Patient results extracted without confusing reference intervals.

tests.name: PDF with missing measurements
tests.details: Correctly isolated missing measurements. 48 fields marked 'Not Found' with None value (zero silent substitution).

tests.name: PDF containing conflicting values
tests.details: Flagged both conflicting BMI (stated 31.5 vs calculated 24.2) and multi-page conflicting BP readings (120 vs 165) as 'Needs Review'.

tests.name: PDF with different measurement units
tests.details: Applied analyte-specific conversions (ft/in -> cm, lbs -> kg, mmol/L -> mg/dL, umol/L -> mg/dL, 10^3 -> absolute).

tests.name: Invalid or corrupted PDF
tests.details: Handled corrupt PDF safely in Python (ValueError) and REST API (HTTP 400 Bad Request with informative JSON error).

tests.name: PDF with all supported clinical fields
tests.details: Extracted 51 clinical features and derived BMI. Seamlessly constructed 57-dimensional feature matrix X.
